<function name="SetExpanded" parent="DCollapsibleCategory" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Sets whether the <page>DCollapsibleCategory</page> is expanded or not upon opening the container.

You should use <page>DCollapsibleCategory:Toggle</page> or <page>DCollapsibleCategory:DoExpansion</page> instead.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<file line="48">lua/vgui/dcategorycollapse.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="expanded" type="boolean" default="true">Whether it shall be expanded or not by default</arg>
	</args>
</function>
